title: Four-sign electrostatic projection isolates polarizability but not passive sorting
statement: For a fixed finite linear conductor in free-space affine field e+Gx, (1/4) sum_(s,t=+-1) st F(se,tG)=G alpha e exactly. Signed demodulation cancels other force parities without a point-dipole approximation.

assumptions: finite electrodes and higher derivatives require residual bounds
costs: four measurements plus a separate sorting actuator
finite conductivity, oxide, charging, drag and photon budget remain engineering costs
contract.units: force and source-local SI field/polarizability units
contract.obstruction: Avoids calling signed metrology a passive net-force sorting operation.

evidence.quote: not a passive positive deflection sorter

review.scope: Exact source-supported extraction only; any scoped substantive acceptance is a separate version-bound review overlay.
